Name: Chest Room for Additional Mine Maps
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a simple implementation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14595]Additional Mine Maps[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14566]Dynamic Map Tiles[/url] to show off the potential of these two mods and provide a template for modders to use. 

You can also just add this mod as a player and have it added to the pool of mine and skull cave maps.

The chest can only be triggered once per game. It contains 10 each of copper, iron, gold, and iridium ore.

[youtube]wND7TuuNpQk[/youtube]


Requires the two mods above, as well as Content Patcher.
